e: From Tswana tshesebe. Probably an alteration of tshephe (“antelope, springbok”).
Named after Anatoliy Ivanovich Tsepin (Анатолия Ивановича Цепина; b. 1946) + -ite.

q: […] the Tsebe, or Spring-Boc, Prong-Boc, or Showy Goat, is perhaps the most graceful in its proportions, and beautifully varied in its colours, of all the antelope tribe.
